senses.gloss: (√רע, v. רעע) to strike against. Nif. נֶאֱרַע to come in contact with (cmp. זווג), to happen, befall (gen. of evil occurrences).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 4:2">Ber. IV, 2</cite> <he>שלא תֵּאָרַע וכ׳</he> (Bab. ed. 28ᵇ <he>שלא יֵאָרַע דבר וכ׳</he>) that no (religious) offence may happen through me (by an erroneous decision &c.).
<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 1:1">Yoma I, 1</cite> <he>שׁמא יארע בו פסול</he> lest something may occur to him to unfit him for services.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 6:5">Esth. R. to II, 7</cite> <he>שיארע על ישראל</he> (read <he>שיארע לישר׳</he>) will happen to Israel; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to strike, befall; (neut. v.) to occur. Y. Kidd. I, 58ᵈ top ולא א׳ מעשה no accident (illegal act) occurred.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 84">Gen. R. s. 84</cite> <he>כל מה שאירע לזה וכ׳</he> whatever befell the one, befell also the other; a. fr.—

M. Kat. II, 1 אֵירְעוֹ אבל (Ms. M. אירע בו) mourning in the family befell him; a. e.—Y. Shek. V, 48ᵈ bot. כך וכך אירע; Y. Dem. I, 22ᵃ אירעון … (read אירעוֹ) so and so it happened to him. Part. Pu. מְאוֹרָע q. v.

senses.gloss: to be added to, to join. Y. Sot. I, 17ᵃ אחת מִתְאַרְעָה לאחת וכ׳ one (sin) is added to the other, until the account is full; Num. R. s. 9.
